observations: Photo 0 shows a blue industrial gearbox with a shaft output on the right and a flange/mounting face on the left.
A label/plate is visible on the gearbox body, but the text is not clearly readable in this photo.
No electric motor is visible in photo 0—only the gearbox.

claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a gearbox; no motor is visible, and the ratio/20hp are not readable.
No import documents, markings, or readable provenance are shown in photo 0.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 cannot confirm internal condition, testing, mileage, or whether it was opened.

risks.risk: The listing may not include the electric motor (photo shows only a gearbox).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the motor nameplate and the full set (gearbox + motor) together, plus the motor shaft coupling area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gearbox only (motor not included).

risks.risk: Gearbox ratio may not be 1:10 (not readable in the photo).
risks.proof: Request a close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate showing ratio/model/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown ratio gearbox (worst-case for matching: treat as not confirmed 1:10).

risks.risk: Power rating (20hp) may be incorrect or not applicable to this gearbox/motor combination.
risks.proof: Request motor nameplate photo (HP/kW) and gearbox rating plate photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed 20hp (worst-case: treat as lower/unknown rating).

risks.risk: Condition/testing claims (no knock, working) cannot be verified remotely; internal wear or noise may exist.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the gearbox running under load (or at least a start-up test) and a sound check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs inspection/possible fault).

risks.risk: Compatibility risks: mounting pattern, shaft diameter, and coupling type may not match the buyer’s setup.
risks.proof: Request measurements/photos: gearbox mounting bolt pattern, input/output shaft diameters and keyway, and coupling type.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility risk (worst-case: assume buyer may need adapters).

proof_requests: Close-up, readable photo of the gearbox nameplate (brand/model, ratio, serial number, input/output specs).
Photos of the electric motor nameplate (HP/kW, voltage, RPM, frame size) and the motor connected/coupled to the gearbox.
Video of the gearbox/motor running (showing smooth operation and any noise).
Photos/measurements of mounting face and both shaft ends (diameters, keyway, coupling type).
response.reason: From photo 0, only a gearbox is clearly visible and the key specs the seller mentions (motor presence, 20hp, and 1:10 ratio) are not readable or verifiable. Missing identity/spec proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
